validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: confirmed independently. This row is EPC Package 11 of Aramco's Master Gas System Expansion Phase 3 (MGS-3): the 56-inch EWJZG-1 trunk from 'Sector Two STS-1' to 'Shoqaiq' (Ash Shuqaiq, Red Sea coast), 462 km. MEED ('Aramco selects contractors for Master Gas System expansion') lists Package 11 = 'Sector two STS-1 to Shoqaiq, covering 462km', 56-inch, contractor Max Streicher. Confirmed by an independent project registry, DMS Projects PRJ00030612 ('Master Gas System Expansion - Phase 3 - Package 11 - Sector II STS 1 to Shuqaiq Pipeline (EWJZG-1)'), and by Blackridge Research's MGS-3 profile (Package 11, 56-inch EWJZG-1, Sector Two STS-1 to Shoqaiq, 462 km, Max Streicher). Not a GEM-only entity. CLASSIFICATION: correct - a high-pressure 56-inch dry-gas transmission trunk (Master Gas System backbone), gas commodity, PipelineType=transmission all correct. ATTRIBUTION: Owner=Aramco correct (Aramco is the MGS owner/operator; EPC contractor is Max Streicher, which is not an owner). Fuel=Gas correct. DUPLICATE CHECK: distinct from its EWJZG-1 sibling segments in the roster - P6729=Package 9 (BGCS-10 to Sector I STS-2, 458 km), P6730=Package 10 (Sector I STS-2 to Sector II STS-1, 310 km), P6731=Package 11 (Sector II STS-1 to Shoqaiq, 462 km). Three consecutive, non-overlapping packages of the same corridor; NOT a double-count. SPEC: length 462 km confirmed (MEED + DMS + Blackridge); diameter 56 in confirmed (MEED + Blackridge). CAVEAT: (1) Capacity blank and cannot be responsibly filled - the only published figure is system-wide (+3.2 bscfd across all of MGS-3), not per-package. (2) Sheet leaves StartLocation/EndLocation/province blank though the sourced route is Sector II STS-1 -> Shoqaiq; a Location [ref] fill is staged below.

fills.researcher_notes: Pairs the previously ref-less Location cluster (which held only StartCountryOrArea/EndCountryOrArea=Saudi Arabia) with a verified endpoint. Package 11 terminates at Shoqaiq (Ash Shuqaiq) on the Red Sea coast per MEED and DMS Projects. Start endpoint 'Sector II STS-1' is an internal Aramco station code, not a mappable place, so StartLocation left blank; province left blank rather than guess between Jazan/Asir.

Left blank deliberately. No per-package throughput is published for Package 11; the only figure available is the system-wide MGS-3 increment (+3.2 bscfd across all 17 packages), which cannot be attributed to a single 462 km trunk without fabricating a number.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: Status=construction still correct. MGS-3 EPC packages (incl. Package 11 / Max Streicher) were awarded on the $25bn / ~$10bn program; construction on the program commenced Q2 2024, on-site activities began January 2025 (Blackridge), and program milestones continued through 2025 (L&T completed a 120 km 56-inch stretch of Package 8; YSG completed Package 8 site buildings by April 2025 per MEED/pipeline-journal). Whole system scheduled for completion Q4 2028. No independent evidence that Package 11 has been commissioned, suspended, or cancelled - it is mid-build, well before the 2028 target, so 'construction' holds and no dormancy rule applies. No Package-11-specific milestone newer than the sheet's 2025-08 update was found; newest dated program evidence of active construction is ~April 2025. StartYear1=2028 is consistent with the Q4 2028 completion target.

summary: P6731 confirmed real, correctly classified transmission gas trunk (MGS-3 Package 11, EWJZG-1 Sector II STS-1->Shoqaiq, 56"/462km, Aramco); status=construction confirmed; not a duplicate of P6729/P6730; capacity left blank.
